name: @bybrawe/opencode-loop
description: Claude Code/Codex style /loop and experimental goal mode for OpenCode: heartbeat scheduler, idle-safe loops, scheduled commands, compact scheduling, verification, checkpoints, and persistent coding goals.

scripts.build:plugin:npm: npm install --no-save --package-lock=false bun@1.3.14 && bun build src/source/v1.js --outfile=src/index.js --target=bun --format=esm --external=@opencode-ai/plugin/tool

scripts.test: node scripts/install-test.mjs && node scripts/loopd-test.mjs && node scripts/smoke-test.mjs && node scripts/comprehensive-test.mjs
